create_timer_instance: create a Timer instance to start tracking elapsed time for a code block
start_timer_with_tic: start the timer by calling tic to record the current start time
stop_timer_with_toc: stop the timer by calling toc to get elapsed time or average across calls
reset_timer_state: reset the Timer to zero out total time, calls, and average time
measure_average_elapsed_time: measure average elapsed time across multiple tic and toc calls on the same Timer
